data.name: Samim
data.gender_notes: Samim is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Samim is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'sam' which means 'calm'. This name is often given to children born during peaceful and tranquil times. The name is also associated with the calmness and tranquility of nature. The name Samim carries the meaning “Calm, Cool, Tranquil” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Samim usually hope their child will grow to embody calm, cool, tranquil and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Samim belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Calm, Cool, Tranquil.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Samim total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

In Hinduism, self-realization is achieved through the pursuit of inner peace and tranquility, and the name Samim is a reminder of this spiritual goal.
